encoding: UTF-8 JSONL; one JSON object per nonblank physical line

fields.recordId: nonblank string <=200 characters; stable within source
fields.deviceKey: nonblank string; source-scoped fixture lookup, unmatched accepted as deviceId/siteId null
fields.captureTime: RFC3339 with seconds, optional 1-6 fractional digits, Z or explicit +/-HH:MM; no numeric timestamps
fields.plateText: nonblank synthetic token; exact explicit reference lookup; no real plate format validation or identity inference
fields.longitude: finite JSON number excluding boolean, [-180,180]; paired null or paired omission allowed
fields.latitude: finite JSON number excluding boolean, [-90,90]; paired with longitude
fields.crs: must equal EPSG:4326 when numeric coordinates are supplied; omitted for unknown location
fields.plateColor: optional string or null; no vendor enum assumed
fields.vehicleImageRef: optional registered synthetic file reference, non-null; omitted when unavailable

digest_scope: whole raw business object including recordId; excludes batch, row number and receivedAt
duplicate: same stable identity + same digest => DUPLICATE; keep original capture and ingestedAt
key_conflict: same stable identity + different digest => REJECTED/FIXTURE_KEY_CONFLICT; do not overwrite
invalid_rows: reject before claiming stable identity; one primary reason per row in this fixture
unknown_device: ACCEPTED + FIXTURE_DEVICE_UNMAPPED warning; deviceId/siteId null; excluded from site-scoped queries
unknown_target: ACCEPTED + FIXTURE_TARGET_UNRESOLVED warning; targetId null, targetType PLATE
display_mask: always SYNTH-PLATE-****; isMasked=true; only tests absence of raw token in public output
uuid_recipe: UUID5(namespace from reference-data.json, str(seed)+':'+entity_label); labels are documented in generator
query_interval: [from,to); stable captureTime DESC,captureId DESC; plain expected pages, not signed API cursors
raw_null_policy: CommonCaptureRecord nullable fields must still be present; PlateRecord.vehicleImageAssetId is omitted, never null
no_real_side_effects: task IDs, file IDs and reference resources are synthetic metadata; no database rows, active files, API requests or tasks were created
